May 22 Margaret Smith ... about 40 ... seemingly determined to gain end - Even at cost of breaking up neighbor's home.
Julia Hinsell - 44 - curverture of spine - fell some months ago .... - was baptized Catholic, received holy sacraments. .. would never be ... other ...
Page 212
May 22 Thanks - Robert Gladfelter - 24 - of 12667 Terry Ave. T.B. cured - home after two years and hoping to get work - Deo Gr.
Thanks - Weldon Trevethan - 3 - was bleeder till last Monday - En- rolled by non-Cath. father .... boy here To-day with mother seemingly cured. Deo Gr.
22 Mrs. Gladys Gheen - 43 - non Catholic - Emrolled To-night Geo. Brady - 38 - rhumatism - has wife & 7 depending
Thomas McEvoy - 11 - infected eye since flue - some months ago
24 Wm. Chiun - non Catholic - 7th Engineer - for Board of Education .... accused of criminal attention to child of 9 yrs ..... Strange - parents seem convinced of innocence of man, but refuse to lift charge. Father belongs to C.S.O. - declared to in-laws. .. It is his job we want."
29 Forest Nobel - 42 - Baptist - skull ....
29 Mrs. Anna Addison - 48 - stroke 18 mo's ago. Still unable to speak .. Mrs. Dorothy Anderson - 31 - floating kidney Jas Tulkowski - stomach. Rabbi Rosenwasser Fr. Coughlin
Page 213 May 30 Arthur Verhaeghe - 42 - Ran away from Grace Hospital after one day ob- servation - cancer of rectum. Enrolls To-day ... promises to go more frequently than once a year if. .
